title: Accelerated Identification of Polar Domains From 4D-STEM Using Group Convolutional Neural Networks
content: 4D-STEM provides a wealth of information in real and reciprocal space, but the extraction of important features remains a time and computationally intensive task. Current workflows for identifying polar domains in 4D-STEM images rely on manual analysis using tools such as py4DSTEM [1]. However, these methods are time-intensive and certain steps are prone to human error, potentially leading to inaccurate results. Previous work has leveraged convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to analyse individual diffraction images from 4D-STEM datasets, utilizing autoencoders to extract polarization domains from latent embeddings [2]. CNNs are particularly well-suited for diffraction pattern analysis due to their inherent translation equivariance, which minimizes the impact of artifacts such as misalignment.
